items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: Wingy (2) Carpenter, I don't know if you know him, trumpet player. The name is Theodore Carpenter.

ctx.x: Were all of these bands your friends around Atlanta?
No, no. I went from Cincinnati ... up here. Wingy (2) Carpenter, I don't know if you know him, trumpet player. The name is Theodore Carpenter.
